title: Asamiya Sahityar Chamu Buranji
author: Prof. Jatindranath Goswami
genre: Compact Literary History & Buranji Historiography of Assam
description: Concise critical manual of Assamese and Tai-Ahom literary history by Prof. Jatindranath Goswami (Jorhat College & Asam Sahitya Sabha), outlining the development of early folk verses, royal court chronicles (Buranji prose), bilingual treaties, religious hagiographies, and modern vernacular resurgence.
